_note: The FROZEN reference population for training_configs/run_default.json's own vs_gauntlet check (gauntlet_league_name: '4_deck_subleague_gauntlet'). Trained ONCE to a fixed target (10,000 games/deck), then left alone -- nothing auto-freezes a league population; simply not training it further IS the freeze, same as the previous 4_deck_subleague_gauntlet population before the 2026-08 fresh start (own-hand-tokenization observation change) invalidated every existing checkpoint and wiped it. Re-created 2026-08-05. Deliberately a NEW file rather than reusing training_configs/run_gauntlet.json, which is intentionally retired/neutered (see its own _note) specifically to stop an accidental pointer at the frozen reference population being trained as if it were live -- writing a fresh file avoids resurrecting that exact trap. Run mechanics (n_workers, checkpoint_opponent_rate, pfsp, snapshot_every_games) are NOT set here -- pass --run-config training_configs/run_default.json alongside this file for those, same shared-mechanics-file convention run_default.json's own _note describes.
